messages:
julia: Quick brainstorming thread  We
re launching a PLG trial experiment next week: trial credits + prompt templates + a short webinar. Need: launch post (120hars-ish), webinar blurb, in-app activation nudge, and experiment plan. Who can take which part?

sam: I can own experiment matrix and tracking. Suggest test cells: $25 vs $100 credits and 7d vs 21d expiry. Primary metric: first successful request within 72h. Secondary: 7-day retention.

own: For the benchmark narrative, recommend a single clear workload: "support thread summarization" (real traffic-like inputs). Ill prepare latency and cost comparisons (hosted std vs optimized config).

tara: Ill assemble 3 prompt template packs: Support Summaries, Search Rerank, Microcopy. Will add 1-click "Run sample" buttons in the template gallery.

nora: From recent cohorts, mid-tier credits ($75ish) get the best balance of usage and retention. Also: segment offers by signup_source so we can see blog vs docs lift.

sam: Draft email/in-app nudge: 
"Subject: Youve got $100 to try Redwoods starter packs"
"Hi {{name}}  we added $100 credits. Try a Starter Pack to see results fast: [Run Support Pack] [Run Search Pack]"
CTA variants: "Run sample" vs "Use pack".

julia: Nice. Marketing needs final copy + webinar landing blurbs by Monday. Owen + Nora please sync today on benchmark numbers. Tara, push templates by Friday. Sam, wire analytics events: signup_source, credits_bucket, first_run_ts, activated_bool.

growth-bot: Scheduled reminder in #marketing for 1758473600 to review launch copy.

julia: Webinar plan: 20m demo, 15m live Q&A, quick benchmark reveal. Auto-grant credits on registration. Keep messaging focused on "fast time-to-value" and "predictable cost controls". Avoid deep infra details. Include one concrete stat in post (e.g., "typical prompt latency ~10-30ms/token on our hosted stack").

own: Will bring a simple chart and 3 bullet points for the post.

sam: Will set up the A/B and deck the post-launch playbook (email cadence + in-app follow-ups).

julia: Action list recap: sam - experiment + tracking; owen+nora - workload + benchmark; tara - prompt packs; sam+tara - nudge & email; julia - draft post + webinar blurb. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
